t: The Human OS: Engineering Optimism and AI Workflow Refinement
s: This article reframes AI as the 'new OS,' advocating for evidence-based optimism by engineers. It contrasts fear-driven narratives with practical insights into refining Python workflows and developing AI immunity through iterative interaction and secure templating.
sub: AI as the 'new Human OS' and societal stratification
Engineering optimism as falsifiable science vs. pessimistic cults
Python workflow refinement with walrus operator and `t-string` for security
Building AI immunity through familiar training data (e.g., Shakespeare)
